This isn't just about selling ebooks or courses; it's about building a commerce stack that's yours, not rented. Your infrastructure should be free from platform restrictions and fees, like Gumroad's 10% on every sale. That's why NOWPayments charges just 0.5% on each transaction. This isn't about payments; it's about digital commerce infrastructure, where you're the owner, not a renter.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture consists of multiple components: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. NOWPayments handles automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, with a 0.5% fee. This isn't a hack; it's a base-layer infrastructure built for the people Stripe locked out. It's not a workaround; it's a solution.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This is built for digital creators in regions where Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle are unavailable or severely restricted. You're not just looking for a payment solution; you're looking for infrastructure sovereignty. You want to sell your ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software, without the need for a platform. With NOWPayments and our Sovereign Stacks, you can do just that.
With NOWPayments, you can save over $9,000 per year by using our solution instead of Gumroad.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The components include GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. NOWPayments handles automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, with a 0.5% fee. Each component is free or low-cost, so you can focus on building your digital product and not on renting infrastructure.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Scaling a sovereign digital store requires no infrastructure changes at any realistic volume level for most individual creators. Cloudflare Workers processes each webhook event independently — ten simultaneous orders are handled as ten separate processes with no queue congestion. Supabase handles hundreds of concurrent database operations on the free tier. Resend delivers 3,000 emails per month on the free tier — enough for significant daily sales volume. Cloudflare Pages serves the storefront to any number of concurrent visitors without capacity constraints. NOWPayments processes payment volume without per-transaction approval delays.

By using our Sovereign Stacks and NOWPayments solution, you can build a sovereign digital commerce stack that's yours, not rented.

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, follow these steps: Choose your Sovereign Stack, like Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) or Edge Commerce Stack ($197). Deploy your stack in 48 hours. Set up your digital product. Connect your NOWPayments account for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. Focus on building and selling your digital products. Don't rent infrastructure; build it, and own it.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I get started with NOWPayments?

To get started with NOWPayments, create an account, and connect your wallet. You'll get an API key, which you can use to integrate NOWPayments into your Sovereign Stack. With NOWPayments, you get automatic webhook firing, no KYC required, and over 300 cryptocurrencies supported.
What is the fee difference between Gumroad and NOWPayments?

The fee difference between Gumroad and NOWPayments is significant. Gumroad charges 10% on every sale, while NOWPayments charges just 0.5% on each transaction. At 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fee difference retains $921.
Can I use NOWPayments with my existing digital product?

Yes, you can use NOWPayments with your existing digital product. Simply connect your NOWPayments account to your Sovereign Stack, and you'll get automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. With NOWPayments, you can receive payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies, without the need for a platform.
How do I handle orders and delivery with NOWPayments?

With NOWPayments, you can handle orders and delivery automatically, using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. You can also use Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. This means you can focus on building and selling your digital products, without the need for manual order management.
Can I use NOWPayments with multiple cryptocurrencies?

Yes, you can use NOWPayments with multiple cryptocurrencies. You can receive payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies, without the need for a platform. This means you can support a wide range of payment options, and increase your sales potential.
